content.title: Home - 2026 NCAA Men’s Final Four Indianapolis
content.text: Welcome to Indianapolis We’re excited to host the biggest celebration of men’s college basketball in history! For the first time ever, four basketball championships will be hosted in the same city. We welcome the 2026 NCAA Divisions I, II, and III men’s basketball championship games as well as the NIT championship to Indianapolis — the city “Where Champions are Crowned.” We can’t wait for you to experience our amazing city! While Indianapolis is renowned for hosting world-class sporting events, there’s so much more to discover. From a thriving culinary and brewing scene to vibrant, one-of-a-kind neighborhoods, Indy offers something for everyone. Whether you’re savoring local flavors, exploring our iconic attractions, or simply soaking in the city’s arts scene, there’s no shortage of ways to make your visit unforgettable. Immerse yourself in our rich culture and experience our legendary hospitality. Stay Up to Date Sign up for our newsletter to stay in the know on all of the happenings around the 2026 Men’s Final Four® in Indianapolis, including upcoming events, volunteer opportunities, and more! "*" indicates required fields Also Coming to Indy in 2026Sunday, April 5, 2026Thursday April 2 and Sunday April 5, 2026 Event Co-Hosts IU Indianapolis is a co-host for the 2026 Men’s Final Four. The school is located Downtown and was established as an independent campus in July 2024 after a decades-long partnership with Purdue University.
